products.label: Modeled wind pressure and Alfvén surface (Garraffo et al. 2017, Figure 3)
products.process: Read each pixel's place on the figure's color scale and the white line's coverage, fill the field under the figure's orbit circles from its neighbors, lay the circles of planets b to g on the orbits the world draws, and draw the pressure on the application's scale palette, more opaque where it is higher, with the Alfvén surface over it as a dashed white line, on the mean plane of the seven planets' orbits.
limitations: A magnetohydrodynamic model, not an observation. TRAPPIST-1's magnetic map is not measured: the model uses the map of the proxy star GJ 3622, scaled to a mean field of 600 G.
The figure prints no color bar, so the colors show where the pressure is higher, not by how much.
The pattern turns with the star, once in 3.3 days; the picture holds one moment, and its turn about the star is arbitrary.
The figure ends at its own circle for planet h, which lies 3.0 % inside the orbit the world draws.
